annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the approval and market surveillance of non-road mobile machinery circulating on public roads and amending Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the approval and market surveillance of non-road mobile machinery circulating on public roads and amending Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
annotation.summary_en: European Commission 2023 proposal for a regulation creating harmonised EU type-approval and market surveillance for self-propelled non-road mobile machinery (up to 40 km/h) circulating on public roads. It replaces fragmented national regimes with a simplified type-approval, mandatory after a transition. It contains no AI-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: EU type-approval required for self-propelled non-road mobile machinery with a maximum design speed of 40 km/h or less
Excludes individual approvals, small series (50 units per year per Member State) and vehicles covered by Regulations 167/2013, 168/2013 and 2018/858
Obligations for manufacturers, importers, distributors and authorised representatives, including certificates of conformity and statutory plates
Commission empowered to adopt delegated acts on detailed technical road-safety requirements
Market surveillance via Regulation 2019/1020, safeguard procedures, an enforcement Forum, and an 8-year national transition
